Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Cali Belun: 21-year-old man, 196 cm (very-tall), unmistakably soft rounded construction with a clearly evident, naturally wider middle, short-to-average limbs, no cinched or flat waist, and gentle limb contours, skin value band-1-lightest. Face: broad oval face; asymmetric brows and broad cheek planes; broad low bridge, full lips; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: black, medium-loose, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: apron-workwear-layers, specifically a work shirt, asymmetrical apron layers, reinforced trousers, and sturdy shoes; a high soft collar and uneven layered hems; bounded palette teal-brown. Visible personal details: an extensive matte botanical tattoo language over one shoulder, torso edge, and forearm; a repaired cuff with bright thread. Make the hair construction the primary recognition silhouette. Maintenance cue: meticulous daily maintenance. Color treatment: lets faded and repaired areas vary the palette. Pose cue: torso angles three-quarter while both arms hang in deliberate asymmetric ease. Include a palm-sized map roll only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow.
